name: Again With the Zapped Giants
summary: At the Forgotten Coast docks, Zorbin Fandazzle has another offer for you. Bring him more residue from Feralas giants shrunk with the Ultra-Shrinker. He can pay far less this time, but promises to spread word of your service.

sections.title: An Encore for the Ultra-Shrinker
sections.body:
Zorbin Fandazzle asks you to shrink giants in Feralas again and bring ten miniaturization residues to the Forgotten Coast docks. There is always room for more, even after your first haul.

He cannot offer nearly as much this time. Instead, he promises to praise your service among his goblin friends, who have quite large ears.

sections.title: Zorbin's Thanks
sections.body: Zorbin Fandazzle is overjoyed that you have come through again, though the coin is less than you are used to. He says word of your great deeds for goblindom is already ringing through the Steamwheedle Cartel's seats of power.

aliases: who gives again with the zapped giants
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle waits by the Forgotten Coast docks in Feralas and asks you for more residue.
This follows Zapped Giants, your first round of residue gathering for Zorbin Fandazzle.
Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker on any kind of giant in Feralas to shrink it. Then find the residue on the shrunken giants.
The giants are along Feralas's western coast.

faq.q: Will Zorbin take more residue another time?
aliases: can i repeat again with the zapped giants
faq.answer: Zorbin says he can always use more residue, so you can return with another batch of ten.
